There is a 1 in 65,535 chance for yellow squiggles to appear over the Yellow Sign's icon in the Collection. The squiggles are random every time. However, the icon will disappear after 9 s and the player have to scroll down the menu to see it, making it very easy to miss when people take too long and/or have no incentive to scroll down.
The Yellow Sign is a reference to
by
, which is known to have served as the inspiration for the writings of

. In the book, it never fully describes the shape and purpose of the Yellow Sign, and it is described instead as "a curious symbol or letter in gold. It was neither Arabic or Chinese, nor as I found afterwards did it belong to any human script."
In

, one of the stories in the collection, suggests that anyone who possesses or sees – even by accident – a copy of the Yellow Sign is susceptible to some form of insidious mind control or possession by the King in Yellow or one of his heirs. The stories also suggest that the original creator of the Yellow Sign was not human and possibly came from a strange alternate dimension. This may explain why there is a shadow of a pair of hands cast on the screen, congratulating the player after getting the Yellow Sign or after defeating
The Ender, which belong to
The Directer.
